top_strength: Jeline expertly gathered detailed logistics information — property type, bedrooms, garage configuration, furniture specifics (TV size, bed frame type), parking access at both locations — creating a solid foundation for an accurate estimate.
coaching_note: Open with the quid pro quo framing ('10–15 minutes, dependable quote, does that sound good?'), ask Their Agenda before any logistics probing, and always close with an explicit ask ('Would you like our help with your move?') — this call skipped all three and never pitched the Two Promises or asked for the business.
